name: Modern Metal Solutions, LLC
old_description: Modern Metal Solutions specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing
about:
Modern Metal Solutions, LLC is a family-owned metal fabrication shop based in Hudson, New Hampshire. The company serves the Greater Boston and New England regions, though it considers select projects farther afield. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The shop designs, fabricates, and installs custom architectural and ornamental metalwork, including stairs, railings, doors, range hoods, fireplace enclosures, and decorative scrollwork. Its craftspeople blend traditional hand techniques with modern technology to produce detailed drawings, fabricate components, apply finishes, and handle on-site installation. The operation manages the full project lifecycle from concept through final installation, but facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Modern Metal Solutions works primarily with architects and builders on custom installations. A noted project includes the 2022 Burpee Hill Construction job in Newbury, New Hampshire, designed by Marcus Gleysteen Architects. The firm focuses on residential and commercial projects that require intricate metal detailing.

The company emphasizes a consultative, seamless experience, positioning itself as a partner that integrates with the client's team. It highlights a commitment to flawless execution, innovation on difficult designs, and a no-shortcuts philosophy that combines hours of handwork with custom technological solutions when needed.
